links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT cleft lip patient education responses (FRES, FKGL)
links.effect: Mean FRES 44.35 and FKGL 10.87, approximately a 10th-grade literacy level, above the commonly recommended patient-material reading level.
links.quote: Readability metrics revealed a mean FRES of 44.35 and a FKGL of 10.87, corresponding to approximately a 10th-grade literacy standard.

links.outcome: Presence of citations/sources in ChatGPT responses to cleft lip questions
links.effect: None of the responses contained grossly inaccurate or harmful information, but the responses lacked citations.
links.quote: None of the responses contained grossly inaccurate or potentially harmful medical information but lacked citations.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-generated patient education responses on cleft lip repair assessed by plastic surgeons for quality, clarity, and readability without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
